featured_reviews.name: Arjun Pitroda
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I recently visited this location and was very pleased with the overall experience. The first thing I noticed was how clean and well-maintained the entire establishment is. The lobby, common areas, and especially the auditorium itself were all spotless, which immediately makes for a better visit. The seating was comfortable, allowing for a relaxed viewing experience.
​From a technical standpoint, the theatre really delivers. The screen quality was excellent—it was bright, clear, and provided a fantastic picture. Equally impressive was the good sound system. The audio was sharp, immersive, and well-balanced, enhancing the movie without being overly loud or muffled.
​If you are looking for a reliable, decent theatre that provides a high-quality visual and audio experience, this is a solid choice. Highly recommended for a satisfying movie night out!

Overall, it’s a solid choice if you're looking for a value-for-money movie experience without sacrificing comfort or convenience.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Aundhakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Maxus Cinemas on Gorai Road, Borivali West recently. Overall, the experience was decent, but there are a few areas that need improvement.

The biggest disappointment was that the movie started almost 30 minutes late, which was quite frustrating and affected the overall experience. The management should ensure better punctuality and timely show schedules.

The theatre is clean and the seating is comfortable. Food quality was surprisingly good, with decent options available and fresh snacks. However, the sound quality was slightly below expectations. The audio lacked depth and could definitely be improved for a better cinematic experience.

Despite these issues, the ambience is pleasant and it's still a good option for a casual movie outing with friends and family. Hoping they improve the sound system and maintain better show timings in the future.

⭐⭐⭐☆☆ (3/5)

featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, really disappointed with my experience at Maxsus Cinema. The picture quality was extremely poor — the screen looked blurry, as if the sharpness wasn’t even set properly. For a premium theatre, this is just unacceptable.

On top of that, the audio was even worse. The speakers were crackling throughout, completely ruining the movie experience. Instead of immersive sound, it felt like sitting next to a broken speaker system.

Even the food was a letdown. The ₹100 sandwich was pathetic — dry, swaggy, and didn’t even have proper butter applied. Completely not worth the price.

Overall, not worth the money at all. Definitely expected much better from a brand like this.

featured_reviews.name: Anish Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Maxus Theatre, Borivali offers a consistently enjoyable movie-watching experience. The ambience is pleasant, seating is comfortable, and the overall layout of the theatre is well maintained, making it a great place to unwind and enjoy a film.
Audio and visual quality are impressive, with clear sound and sharp screen projection that enhance the cinematic experience. Cleanliness is well taken care of across the premises, including the seating areas and washrooms, which adds to the comfort.

Staff are courteous and helpful, and the entry and exit process is smooth without unnecessary delays. The food counter offers decent options, and service is efficient even during peak hours.

Overall, Maxus Theatre stands out as a reliable and comfortable theatre in Borivali, ideal for family outings as well as casual movie plans. Definitely a good choice for a hassle-free movie experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sureshkumar Nagarajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited PVR LIDO Juhu for the first time on 21st Sept 2025 to watch "The God Father" Rerelease!

This property is easy to navigate and it is just right on the main road side.

Really impressed with the colourful entrance. Though it is a smaller in size, but the aesthetical looks stunned me.
It given me dazzling bollywood look and feel!!
The Lobbies from main entrance to each theatres are featuring great interiors 👍👍

This property has 3 screens. While screen 1 and 2 are compact theatres, Screen 3 is a bit bigger.

Seatings are at top most comfort with food tray attached to each seat. Each row has big legroom.

Provided Screen size is maximum with respect to Auditorium size is a big plus.

They equipment Atmos system for even these small auditorium. Only drawback in Audio during my show was there was a beep sound making noise in the background.

Projection clarity is too good.

Airconditioning was just right.

Wash rooms are well installed and maintenaned.

Free drinking water facility is good and appreciable.

F&B items prices are high as usual for a PVR cinema.

Major drawback in this entire premises is Low Mobile Network.

Overall it is a nice and different cinema experience in PVR LIDO. Be prepared to watch movie here in a compact sized Theatres. If you come with an expectation of bigger screen experience, PVR LIDO may disappoint you.
Good idea to bring kids to this theater!!!

featured_reviews.name: Geeta Pariani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have no complaints about this multi screen cinema complex. The seating, the ambiance, the maintenance are all top notch. The only complaint I have is the sound volume in the hall. Whether it is ads, previews or the main feature film, the volume of the sound system is too loud. Yesterday I watched a film and came back with ringing ears. Despite requesting a staff member at the start of the film, nothing was done about this. I have decided that I shall either not return to this place or, if I have no other choice, I'll wear ear plugs to muffle the decibel level. Patrons may not realise now, but listening to such high volumes over even a short duration, can and will make one lose their hearing faculty.
This is very serious and ALL CINEMA HALLS SHOULD HAVE A DECIBEL MEASURING SYSTEM IN PLACE.
I KNOW WHAT IT IS TO HAVE A HEARING IMPAIRMENT. My son is hearing impaired.

DO NOT RISK YOUR EARS by allowing cinema halls to force you to listen to such high volumes

featured_reviews.name: Abhijeet Kini
featured_reviews.review_text: Though it’s a very aesthetically pleasing place, especially the interiors as well as the big mural outside, lots of teething problems and apathy of staff. Starting off, the screens 1 and 2 being next door to each other, we could hear the sounds from the next screen during our movie. Quite distracting. The movie was a 530 show, and the cleaning board was left hanging till 530, and it’s only when I asked the staff at the snacks counter, one of them strolled up casually, peeped inside and took off the board. Else we would’ve just waited on and on. The men’s loo wasn’t working on the 1st floor (of our scteens) and we had to go to 3rd floor to use the same. 3rd floor had an entire gang of the pvr staff ganged up and fooling around loudly, blocking the way to the washroom. The parking is pricey, and i saw that the parking attendant is using the UPI code of his own name and not a business account. Not sure if hes pocketing it or it's going to legit use. all in all, lots of things to look into.

featured_reviews.name: Jaimeen Bulsara
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Ajanta Cinex. This was our second time coming here. Tucked away in a by-lane, very close to the station (if you’re coming by train) as well as ample parking (if you prefer to come by car/bike) it is super convenient to reach. The movie watching experience itself is amazing, it is currently the only single screen theatre with Dolby sound system. Clean, comfortable seating, delicious food options (we tried the momos, pizza, and coffee, along with the usual samosa and popcorn). The freshly made momos and pizza were better than some of the food places we’ve eaten at. Overall a total 5 on 5 experience. Would definitely come again soon.

featured_reviews.review_text: The staff seemed untrained. The theatre was renovated, but cleaning needs attention there was a slight smell inside, not too strong but enough to distract while watching the movie. They should also put clear directions outside the mall since there are two entrances. At one entrance, the watchman was chewing gutka and just threw hand signs when I asked where the theatre was, which didn’t feel professional. Another odd thing was at the last 10 minutes of the movie, the lights were turned on while it was still playing. On the positive side, the ticket prices were low, the seats were good, and the washrooms were clean, so overall 3 stars for that

featured_reviews.name: Krittika Khandare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review to document a serious food safety incident at PVR, Jio World Plaza, BKC.

On 15 January 2026, I attended the 6:00 PM show of Avatar 3 in Audi 6. Before the movie, I purchased food from the PVR counter. While eating it during the show, the final bite contained a visible piece of glass that entered my mouth. I immediately spat it out. The fact that I was not physically injured was purely a matter of luck, this could have caused severe internal injury or worse.

I have video evidence clearly showing the glass shard in the food.

What has been equally disturbing is the way this matter has been handled since. Despite multiple emails, follow-ups, and assurances that the issue was being taken seriously, there were significant delays, inconsistent communication, and ultimately a response stating that no lapse could be established at their end. The only gesture initially offered was complimentary movie tickets, which is entirely inappropriate for a life-threatening food safety incident.

As a paying customer, being exposed to such a risk and then experiencing weeks of delay and deflection has been deeply distressing. This review is being posted so that other patrons are aware and so that this concern is documented publicly after private escalation failed to lead to a responsible resolution.

I hope PVR reviews its food safety accountability and customer handling practices more seriously going forward.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Jio PVR recently for an evening weekday show. The theatre itself was extremely clean, the seats were very comfortable, and the cooling was VERY strong — honestly, carry a jacket if you’re planning to watch a movie there because it gets quite cold inside. The overall ambience and maintenance were excellent.

Ticket pricing between ₹250–₹500 feels reasonable considering the cleanliness and comfort, especially if booked smartly on weekdays.

But as usual with PVR, the food pricing is absurd. Ordered a ₹350 Schezwan Paneer Wrap and it was a complete waste of money. The taste was terrible and definitely not worth the price. They serve it properly with a tray, plate, and cutlery, but realistically, how convenient is that setup inside a movie theatre while watching a film in the dark?

Popcorn and drinks are also heavily overpriced, and the quantity doesn’t justify the cost either.

Overall: great theatre experience for seating, cleanliness, and ambience — but avoid spending too much on the food unless you’re okay paying premium prices for average quality.

featured_reviews.name: Faraz Ansari
featured_reviews.review_text:
PVR Dynamix Juhu is one of the most popular cinemas in the area and definitely offers a good overall movie experience. The location is very convenient, being inside Dynamix Mall above Shoppers Stop, which makes it easy to access and also provides plenty of options for food or shopping before and after a show. The ambience of the cinema is clean, modern and well maintained, giving a premium feel as soon as you step in. The staff are generally polite and helpful, managing crowds well even during busy showtimes. The washrooms and lobby are also kept tidy, which adds to the comfort of the visit.

The technical quality of the cinema is one of its strongest points. The picture quality is sharp, bright and clear, and the sound system really enhances the experience. Whether it is a Hollywood blockbuster or a Bollywood release, the visuals and audio make the screening immersive. The food and beverage options are also decent, with fresh popcorn, nachos and other standard cinema snacks available. Although the prices are on the higher side, the taste and presentation are satisfactory.

The only real drawback is the seating. While everything else matches a premium standard, the seats are not as comfortable as expected. They feel a little cramped, especially during long movies, and the legroom is limited. In some screens, the distance from the seats to the screen can also feel slightly awkward, making the viewing angle less comfortable if you are seated too close.

Overall, PVR Dynamix Juhu is a great place for a movie outing, with excellent sound, visuals, ambience and service. If the seating comfort improves, it would easily become one of the best cinema experiences in Mumbai. I would rate it 4 out of 5.

As for the multiplex itself, it was clean, well-maintained, and the ambiance was quite inviting.

The staff at INOX were courteous and helpful, right from the ticket counter to the ushers inside the theater. The seating was comfortable, with good legroom and clear visibility from every angle. The sound and picture quality were up to the mark, giving a great cinematic experience. I especially liked the recliner section, which was a bit more expensive but definitely worth it for long movies.

The only reason I'm giving 4 stars instead of 5 is because the food prices at the snack counter are on the higher side, which is typical for multiplexes but still feels excessive. Also, during peak hours, the entry and exit process can feel a bit rushed and crowded.

Overall, INOX Raghuleela is a great place to watch movies with friends or family. I’d definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a good movie-going experience in Kandivali.

Fun Cinemas, located on the 4th floor of K Star Mall in Chembur, offers a standard movie-going experience with some notable positives and areas that could use improvement. One of the standout aspects of this theatre is its diverse language screenings, including Tamil, Malayalam, Telugu, Hindi, and English. This makes it a great option for regional movie lovers in Mumbai who want to catch films in their native language.

The sound and visual quality are commendable, with Dolby Atmos enhancing the audio experience and the screen clarity being satisfactory. These technical aspects ensure that the core movie-watching experience is enjoyable. The theatre is also conveniently located near Diamond Garden and is close to Ghatala railway station, making it easily accessible for locals and commuters.

However, the theatre's location in an old and mostly abandoned mall detracts significantly from the overall experience. The mall feels deserted, especially at night, which creates an eerie and isolated atmosphere. Inside, the seating, although slightly repaired and improved, is still average, with some chairs showing signs of wear and tear. The maintenance of the premises is also below par, with cleanliness in common areas needing much more attention.

The food and beverage options are decent, with the nachos and cool drinks standing out as personal favorites. However, like most multiplexes in Mumbai, the prices are high, which doesn’t always align with the quality or portion sizes. There have also been occasional complaints about stale food, which is disappointing.

In conclusion, Fun Cinemas in K Star Mall is a decent choice if you’re looking to watch movies in regional languages or live nearby. However, the outdated ambiance, maintenance issues, and high prices make it a less appealing option compared to other multiplexes in the city.

Today I visited PVR Ghatkopar East to watch the movie Raje Shivaji. During the movie, the screen suddenly went off in the middle of the show. Unfortunately, no staff member took the initiative to inform or assist the audience regarding the issue.
After informing the Duty Manager, Mr. Suryavanshi, he stated that there was a technical issue in the backend due to which the movie got stuck. However, instead of apologizing for the inconvenience caused, his behavior was rude and unprofessional. He simply mentioned that the movie would restart in the next 15 minutes.
When we expressed our disappointment and asked why the movie experience was being disturbed, he responded by saying that it was a technical issue and that he could not do anything about it.
As customers, we expect at least basic courtesy, proper communication, and respectful behavior during such situations. Overall, we felt that there was no concern shown towards customers’ time, money, or emotions.
I kindly request you to look into this matter seriously and ensure that polite, responsible, and customer-friendly managers are assigned to handle such situations in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the worst cinema experience at PVR Kandivali. To start with, water was literally leaking from the ceiling onto our seats. Instead of fixing the issue, they just threw a flimsy blue plastic sheet over the seats! It felt like sitting in a rundown shack. Some seats had broken cushions, making it incredibly uncomfortable to sit for the entire movie.

On top of that, the AC wasn’t working, and the whole theatre had a horrible damp, musty smell. It felt like they haven’t maintained the place in ages. The icing on the cake? The volume was cranked up so high, it was uncomfortable and borderline painful to sit through the movie. It didn’t enhance the experience, it made it worse.

This is hands down the worst PVR I’ve ever been to. If you’re planning to watch a movie here, do yourself a favor and go elsewhere. Total waste of time and money!
